full_judgment:
Md. Abdul Wahhab Miah J.:- The plaintiff has filed this petition for leave to appeal against the judgment and order dated the 23rd day of July, 2012 passed by the High Court Division in First Miscellaneous Appeal (FMA) No. 144 of 2009 dismissing the appeal and discharging the connected Rule being Civil Rule 389 (fm) of 2009. 

 2. Short facts necessary for disposal of this petition arc that the petitioner herein as plaintiff filed Title Suit No. 116 of 2009 in the Court of joint District Judge, 5th Court, Dhaka for declaration that the delivery challan and the bill of exchange submitted by defendant No. 1 under back to back Letter of Credit (L/C) No. 167308040640 dated 23.04.2008 arc forged and fabricated and as such, not binding upon him as the same were submitted in violation of terms of the said L/C. In the suit, the plaintiff filed an application for temporary injunction for restraining defendant No. 2-Dutch Bangla Bank Ltd from disbursing the amount of money against the said L/C. The learned Joint District judge by order No. 2 dated 06.05.2009 rejected the application. Against the order dated 06.05.2009, the plaintiff-petitioner tiled FMA No. 144 of 2009 before the High Court Division and in that appeal filed an application praying for issuing Rule calling upon the defendant-responder its to show cause as to why order No. 2 dated 06.05.2009 passed by the Joint District Judge, 5th Court, Dhaka in Title Suit No. 116 of 2009 should not be set aside and also made a prayer for an ad-interim injunction restraining defendant No. 2 from disbursing the amount against the said L/C. A Rule being C.R No. 389 (FM) of 2009 was issued on 25.05.2009 in the terms as prayed for and an interim order was also passed restraining defendant No. 2-respondent from disbursing the amount of money against the L/C.
